judgement.reason: HomeBox supports PostgreSQL by setting and its storage connection string can point at S3, so the change is contained.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /data (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The production image keeps uploaded files on local disk through HBOX_STORAGE_CONN_STRING=file:///, and its default SQLite database lives under /data, so /data holds durable state and no shown line moves that data to a supported service.
